request: Twenty additional catalog-wide review passes: expand reliable coverage, reduce false positives, simplify shared code and measure performance.

passes.evidence: All 292 source-owned rules, metadata, matching cases and non-matching cases enumerated.
Aliases are rewritten using binding information; Python rewrites exclude shadowing and string annotations.
Maintained ASTUtils.getPropertyName reused; dynamic keys retain existing exclusions.
No-substitution template keys preserve method names; private-key handling remains with its owner.
Parentheses preserve receivers; HCL strips only complete balanced outer pairs. A typed TypeScript script fixture was corrected to declare module context.
Erased assertions preserve existing scope, provenance, writes and argument-count guards.
Receiver assertions retain binding identity; type-sensitive rules are excluded from this mutation.
Two additional gaps reproduced and fixed at existing expression recognizers.
Only non-TSX inputs are transformed; type-sensitive rules remain excluded.
Combination checks retain outcomes; Python comment policies and SQL dialect ownership retain their own semantics.
LF and CRLF outcomes preserve authored labels; SQL coordinates are independently compared across all offsets.
Optional UTF-8 signatures are accepted consistently by Python entry, project, local and imported-fact readers. Embedded U+FEFF is preserved.
Whole positive and negative examples moved into comments; comment-policy and suppression owners are excluded because comments are their policy inputs.
Discarded TypeScript SQL values no longer report. Executed queries inside void calls and interpolations continue to report.
Full owning suites plus 16 new near-miss cases protect foreign/shadowed receivers, dynamic keys, mutation, escapes and storage overloads.
Full authored/private example suites and package tests exercise generated files, fixture paths, exact suppressions and baselines; existing contracts are retained.
Full precedence suites, independent Unicode/CRLF offset oracle, malformed-source deduplication and clean second-pass fixes. No duplicate probe locations or exact corpus duplicates.
Shared erased-expression, Python decoding, HCL parenthesis and SQL location helpers. Diagnostic owner parsing reuses context; SQL retains one source index and resets it at analysis boundaries.

Already-local public and private pins checked before and after isolated scans. Full native catalog and 112 untyped TypeScript rules compared; paired fresh-process benchmarks and cold/warm stress checks recorded.
make verify, source-owned catalog and ledger checks, type checks, all package tests, self-lint, package version causality and exact-revision PR CI.

decisionDefinitions.valid-python-decoding: A Python-valid UTF-8 BOM prevented the existing owning rule from parsing source. Normalize optional signatures at shared and dependency input boundaries; retain embedded characters, strict/replacement decoding contracts, suppressions and severity.
decisionDefinitions.static-typescript-recognition: A source-owned bad example escaped recognition under a statically identical property name or erased receiver assertion. Use maintained static property extraction and shared erased-wrapper recognition before the existing scope/type/provenance guards.
decisionDefinitions.discarded-sql-false-positive: Two SQL advisories reported on provably discarded SQL-shaped carrier strings. Exclude only discarded text; still visit effectful nested query calls.
decisionDefinitions.simplify-or-speed: No new rule judgment: reuse existing semantic helpers, remove repeated lookups or replace prefix copying/counting with bounded shared line indexes. Retain original findings and diagnostic coordinates.
decisionDefinitions.retain: No further evidenced safe expansion in these passes. Preserve the source-owned catalog limitations and severity rather than broadening a heuristic.

fixtureCorrections.correction: Add export {} to declare module context for top-level await under typed project parsing. The parentheses discrepancy was a fixture ambiguity; independently labeled module-context assertion cases reproduced the receiver gaps.

admission.routing: sarj-ai/code-standards: parsed source semantics and lint-engine behavior
admission.ownerPolicy: Every expansion modifies an existing owner; no new rules or severity promotions.
admission.harm: Existing documented violations become invisible under valid source encodings or erased/static-equivalent syntax; discarded SQL strings create misleading diagnostics.
admission.labelsBeforeImplementation: BOM, imported-fact, precedence, static-member, assertion and discarded-SQL regressions were labeled before their corresponding implementations.
admission.upstreamOwner: @typescript-eslint/utils ASTUtils.getPropertyName owns static member decoding; semantic wrappers remain an internal shared helper.
admission.smallestBoundary: Normalize input/expression facts before existing ownership checks; retain type, scope, shadowing, write, argument, path and generated-source gates.
admission.fixVerification: New optional-array-default transformations have authored fixed outputs and require a clean, unchanged second pass.

methodology.scope: Catalog-wide review does not mean every mutation applies to every language or rule. No-op dispositions retain an explicit source-owned scope.
methodology.probeProtocol: Run source-owned examples in isolated projects; preserve siblings, typed tsconfig and import bindings. Type-sensitive rules are not given receiver type-changing mutations. Masking probes exclude owners of comments, prose and suppressions.
methodology.comparison: Engine baseline is the exact previous merge; corpus pins are independent earlier snapshots. No corpora are refreshed, fetched or mutated.
methodology.reproducibility: Permanent fixtures reproduce the demonstrated expansions and negatives. Original documented examples, package suites and make verify reproduce the admission gate.

corpusInspection.classification: Compare every finding by corpus, file, line, column and rule. No new matches require classification. Existing distinct-message findings at one owner location retain their counts; this is not a fresh TP/FP classification of all 23,669 unchanged findings.
corpusInspection.limits: Raw corpus scans cover Python/SQL/HCL and untyped TypeScript. Five mandatory type-service rules and all text rules are exercised by authored typed fixtures/full package suites. Private corpus identities, roots, snippets and hashes are omitted.

performance.interpretation: SQL diagnostic generation improves on long files; standalone Python deduplication parses once instead of three times, and an existing file context requires no parse. Whole-catalog paired medians remain within measured run-to-run variation; no general end-to-end speedup is claimed.
performance.coldWarmProtocol: Each SQL size runs once cold then five times warm; report the warm median and require identical golden finding coordinates. Python deduplication uses 300 seven-line functions, six raw owner diagnostics per function, five repetitions and 900 retained diagnostics.
performance.cacheBounds: Only the current SQL source index is retained; analysis startup clears it. No path/content-based stale reuse is introduced.
performance.timingLimit: Benchmark wall times can be affected by concurrent local verification; scanner times exclude module imports. Process totals include startup for corpus batches.

release.immutableTags: No existing release tag is retargeted; affected packages and exact sibling pins are bumped together.
